meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 收到设计后，Claude 会按 Dieter Rams 的十条“好设计”原则逐条打分并附证据，判定应新建、优化还是重做，再生成一个可交给 /make-plan 的提示。不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你说出“audit this design”、“design review”、“design audit” 等审计请求，或要求按 Rams 十原则点评某个设计并导向后续方案时触发。

say.text: 审计这个界面，按 Rams 十原则打分。
这个 UI 设计好不好？用 design-is 分析一下。
say.note: 会给出结论和后续规划。

say.text: 检查我的设计稿，告诉我该重做还是微调。
say.note: 先锁定范围再收集证据。

howto.what_en: Claude will audit the given design against Dieter Rams' ten principles, score each 0–3 with cited evidence, decide between NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN, and produce a runnable /make-plan prompt. It does not write implementation code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "design audit", etc., or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

say_en.text: Audit this interface and score it against Rams' ten principles.
say_en.note: It will produce a report and scorecard.

say_en.text: Is this UI good? Analyze it with design-is.
say_en.note: You'll get a verdict and next steps.

say_en.text: Review my design file — should I redesign or refine?
say_en.note: It scopes first, then gathers evidence.
